finalText:
**It is a 94 file rename, and four zones must not be touched.**

| Zone | Files | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` | 75 | Safe to rename |
| `migrations/**` | 12 | Freeze. Applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | Freeze. Overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh` |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | Freeze. Public contract |

Also freeze the right side of `WIRE` in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8). That map is the wall. Rename the key, keep the value `account_id`.

So the real work is 75 service files, plus `lib/audit.js`. Ask the team to confirm audit log consumers first.
